labels.caption: Caption
labels.heading: Heading
labels.name: Name
labels.question: Question
labels.show_note: Let customers add an order note
labels.sticky_header: Stick to the top on scroll

info.all_products_fallback: Leave empty to link to all products.
info.availability: Small chip over the product image, for example: In stock. Leave empty to hide.
info.badge: Small rotated sticker over the image. Leave empty to hide.
info.block_corner_radius: Applies to cards, images and panels. Set to 0 for hard edges.
info.brand_colors: These three colors drive every section band. Changing them re-skins the whole site.
info.support_color: Small indicators only, such as the in-stock dot. Never used for text.
info.buy_url: Where Buy now goes. Leave empty to use the featured product’s own page.
info.cart_product: Where the empty-cart button sends people. Falls back to the featured product.
info.collection_fallback: Leave empty to show all products.
info.cta_link_fallback: Only used when no product is selected.
info.demo_asset: Filename of a bundled demo photo in assets/, used only until a real image is picked above. Clear before launch.
info.display_font: Any Google Fonts family name, for example Fredoka. Leave empty to use the heading font instead.
info.display_optical_size: Only for variable fonts with an optical size axis, such as Bodoni Moda. Turn off for any other family.
info.featured_product: The product the site sells. Every section falls back to this, so swapping it here changes the whole site.
info.free_shipping_threshold: Shows progress toward free shipping. Set to 0 to hide. This is display only — set the real rate in Shopify shipping settings.
info.gallery_image: Falls back to the product image at this position, then to the demo file below.
info.heading_fallback: Leave empty to use the product title.
info.image_override: Replaces the product image. Leave empty to use the product's own images.
info.kicker: Leave empty to use the product kicker from Theme settings.
info.link_fallback: Leave empty to link to the product.
info.min_column_width: Columns wrap automatically once they would be narrower than this.
info.outline_width: Thickness of the outlines around cards and buttons. Set to 0 to remove them.
info.overlay_opacity: Higher values darken the photo so the text stays legible over it.
info.product: Choose the product this section features.
info.product_fallback: Leave empty to use the featured product from Theme settings.
info.product_kicker: Short line shown above the headline, for example: The original portable brew
info.rating_label: Read out by screen readers in place of the stars.
info.reveal_after: Only used on pages with no hero section; otherwise the bar appears as the hero scrolls away.
info.section_rhythm: Vertical space above and below every section.
info.show_buy_now: Shopify’s accelerated checkout. Only appears if it is enabled in your payment settings.
info.show_note: A free-text field sent through to the order.
info.show_second_image: Shows the second product image while hovering, when there is one.
info.show_shop_button: A permanent way to reach the product from every page.
info.show_swatches: Shows one swatch per product variant, up to eight.
info.show_wallets: Shop Pay, Google Pay and PayPal, when enabled in Shopify. They skip the cart.
info.speed: Seconds for one full loop. Higher is slower.
info.statement_text: One short line over a full-width image. Keep it to a single sentence.
info.sticky_bar: Appears once the visitor scrolls past the hero, so the buy action is always one tap away.
info.sticky_header: Keeps the header visible as the page scrolls.
info.unit: Set in the body font at label size, beside the figure.
info.value: The figure itself. Set large in the display font.
info.wordmark: The logo is drawn as live text, not an uploaded image, so it stays sharp at every size and can follow the band color.
info.wordmark_font: Any Google Fonts family name. Leave empty to use the heading font.
info.wordmark_gold: Four stops, toned from the brand palette. The metallic finish reads best on a dark band.
info.wordmark_optical_size: Only for variable fonts with an optical size axis, such as Bodoni Moda. Turn off for any other family.
info.wordmark_subtext: Small letterspaced line under the name. Usually left empty.
info.wordmark_text: Leave empty to fall back to the store name.
info.wordmark_use_gold: Turn off on colored bands, where the mark inherits the band text color instead.
